app.title: RAM-Altman: a bash script that emails Sam Altman about your unused RAM
app.description: A small Bash script that emails a predefined address with information about unused RAM in the system.
proposed_tests: Run the script with a mock SMTP server and capture the email payload
Verify that the script correctly parses /proc/meminfo to compute unused RAM
Check that the email is sent only when unused RAM exceeds a threshold
Measure execution time to ensure it completes within 1 second
